note: This receipt adds HTTP negative assertions and documentation. Minidump parsing and ingestion are unchanged.
covered: POST /api/{project}/minidump/ authenticates the DSN version and key and rejects a wrong key with 403
the multipart upload_file_minidump field is required; gzip request bodies and bounded extra fields are accepted
a body above MAX_BODY_BYTES returns 413; malformed multipart and a missing upload field return 400
failed requests create no event and the raw minidump is never stored as an attachment
the public Minidump directory, SystemInfo, ThreadList, ModuleList, Exception and Memory64 streams are parsed and Memory64 file ranges are validated
the exception thread context is selected, with bounded fallbacks when it is absent; partial or mismatched contexts do not fall back
AMD64 accepts the 1232-byte base or an appended XSTATE area up to 16384 bytes only with flag 0x40
x86 accepts the 716-byte base, architecture 0 and the same bounded XSTATE rule
ARM32, ARM64, legacy Breakpad ARM64 and RISC-V64 contexts are distinguished, including end-to-end RISC-V64 ingestion
module identity is read from RSDS or the ELF BpEL build-id record without the RSDS minimum
limits: The app-level tests use a disposable local PostgreSQL and synthetic Minidump fixtures, not the final image or a real SDK crash.
No public CI or external publication was exercised in this increment.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
